# Tobi Oladimeji

> Data and AI professional, product founder, and community builder based in Waterloo Region, Ontario, Canada. Turns messy data into decisions people can act on.

Tobi is the founder of Inscend, helping founder-led beauty brands find what's holding their products back and get help fixing it, and the founder/CEO of Data Fellows, a global data and technology community with 1,600+ members. He also advises Granted Technologies Inc. on data architecture and AI-assisted workflows.

## Current work

- **Inscend** (https://www.inscend.io/): Decision intelligence for founder-led beauty brands. Combines product research with business operating context to investigate what's holding products back and prepare work that improves and protects sales, with founders in control of consequential decisions.
- **Data Fellows** (https://datafellowsai.com/): A global data and technology ecosystem focused on practical learning, community, products, and making data useful to people and businesses.
- **Granted Technologies Inc.**: Strategic advisor on data architecture, quality controls, workflow design, and AI-assisted grant-data processes.

## Background

Previously worked as a Data Analyst at PwC (Dynamics AX to Dynamics 365 F&O migration), a Data Analyst & Machine Learning Engineer at ESGTree (Power BI, SQL/Python, LLM-based document extraction), and a Data Analyst at AgroMall (operational dashboards). Postgraduate Diploma in Business Analytics from Conestoga College; B.Sc. in Computer Science from Landmark University.

## Notable projects

- Inscend Source Agent and Granted Source Agent: Gemini-powered AI agents (with Google Search grounding) that discover and score leads and non-dilutive funding opportunities.
- Several Power BI, SQL, and Python data-analysis projects, listed at https://tobioladimeji.com/#work.
